notes: Sixteen Hoodline items were queued and four were read here; three name no street number at all, including two stories that plainly happened at a building — a $5.3M seniors' clubhouse finished in the Sunset after 21 months, and Cinderella Bakery finally opening on 24th Street after an eight-year fight. Neither article prints the number, so neither can be placed on a parcel. The one address hit is recorded below and declined.

coverage.note: Two addresses were flagged in the block-party story. "43 Masonic" is not an address: the text reads "between Clayton and Masonic streets", and the 43 is the tail of an unrelated number. 530 Haight St is real and is the finding below.

findings.description: Recorded so the story is not read again. The news here is a one-day free block party on Haight Street for a band's album release, held at the bar's current Upper Haight address. What the article says about 530 Haight is history it recounts rather than reports — the bar operated there for more than 30 years and closed in March 2020 — and it is history Hoodline itself published at the time. An event held in the street outside a building is not a fact about a building.

citation.locator: “A Pub That Helped Launch the Band”

raw.text: Mad Dog in the Fog operated for more than 30 years at 530 Haight St in the Lower Haight before closing in March 2020

publish.note: Declined on the ten-year test. The story is a block party — an event in the street, on one afternoon, for a record release — and the rulebook rejects exactly that: a story that names an address as the venue of an event gives the page nothing. The 2020 closure is a real building fact, but it is not this story's news and Hoodline reported it six years ago; if it is worth a page it is worth citing that report, not this one. The resolver has since put the address on parcel 0848004, so the decline is a judgement about the story and not about the address.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 530 HAIGHT ST → parcel 0848004; sf-parcels has blklot 0848004 active, 500–530 HAIGHT; the 2025 roll records it as multi-family residential, built 1900. EAS puts 500, 504, 506, 508, 510, 512, 514, 516, 518, 520, 522, 524, 526, 528, 530 HAIGHT ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 500.
resolution.note: No page at this path yet; the parcel is the publisher's to seed.
